mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by Fireman's Park tonight with a waxing crescent moon. The ISS passes overhead, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 57 degrees with rain in the forecast.
Verona Police have released their weekly report for October 5 through October 12, documenting several traffic incidents and a warrant arrest in the Prairie Oaks Drive area.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the local events include the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, live music at Paddy Mac's, and trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, or Paddy Mac's.
On October 9, a two-vehicle crash occurred on USH 18/151 near mile marker 76, which resulted in a driver being cited for unsafe lane deviation.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 53 minutes, so please plan accordingly if you would like to stop by.
